T: Sydney, 1959. Continental food comes to the party.
D: A bookish teenager takes a summer job at a Sydney department store and is taken under the wing of its European staff.
P: Serve the mains when Magda welcomes everyone to her New Year's Eve party.
S: Salami, Hungarian sausage, pickled cucumbers, rye bread and soft cheese, the European spread that wowed 1959 Sydney.
Soft white bread with egg, mayo and cress, crusts off, cut into neat fingers for the ladies' tea.
a Hungarian spread from Rudi's side of the table
Soft cheese beaten with butter, paprika, capers, onion and caraway, spread thick on dark rye.
M: the Hungarian cooking Fay falls for
Chicken thighs braised with onion, sweet paprika and capsicum, finished with sour cream, over buttered noodles.
Red capsicums filled with beef, rice, onion and paprika, then baked in a rich tomato sauce until tender.
W: a European cake for an Aussie summer
Lemon and poppy seed butter cake baked in a loaf tin and glazed with lemon icing.
K: Black tea brewed in a pot, poured into china cups with milk and sugar.

s.how: Slice 150g salami and 150g kabana and lay them out on a big board. Add 6 dill pickles cut into spears, 200g cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.

Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Spread over 4 slices white bread, scatter with cress and top with 4 more slices. Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

m.note: the Hungarian cooking Fay falls for
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften 2 onions and 1 red capsicum in the pan. Stir in 2 tbsp sweet paprika, add 375ml chicken stock and the chicken, and simmer 30 minutes. Stir 200g sour cream through off the heat and serve over 400g buttered egg noodles.

w.note: a European cake for an Aussie summer
w.how: Beat 180g butter with 180g sugar, add 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 220g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp poppy seeds and 80ml milk. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

d.how: Warm a teapot, add 4 tsp black tea and 1L just-boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Pour into china cups with milk and sugar on the side, the way the Goodes tearoom served it.
